exceptions.reason: Residual two-member type-level SCC in cli/ after card #1 (33→6) and card #1b (6→2) collapsed the original ARCH-CYCLE-TYPE-03 SCC. The remaining cycle is a TS module graph artifact: subcommands/index.ts types its lazy-loader map as Record<string, SubcommandHandler>, which causes TypeScript to eagerly resolve each dynamic-import target's full return type, keeping handlers/audit.ts transitively loaded into index.ts's type graph even though runtime dependencies are strictly one-way (runtime cycles: 0). Breaking the residual requires either dropping SubcommandHandler from subcommands/index.ts (casting at the composition root) or splitting the loader registry from the typed subcommands export — handled by card #1c. Re-reviewed on introduction; next review 2026-10-01.
exceptions.removeWhen: handlers/audit.ts is no longer in the live type graph reachable from subcommands/index.ts — typically by removing SubcommandHandler from the subcommands map type and casting at the composition root, or by extracting the typed subcommands map to a separate module.
